name: Corsa PRO Control TLR

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store pages do not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Corsa PRO race tire with a tougher build for rough roads, cobbles and wet race days.
pressure_note: The store page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Vittoria says it adds grip on rain-slicked tarmac for rough race days.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store in euros and by a Vittoria Tmall store in mainland China; the US store did not load on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

price_observations.market: Vittoria Tmall store (vittoria运动户外旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 467.

caveats: Measured wet grip (73) was close to the regular Corsa PRO (74) despite the wet-weather positioning.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.

image.shown: Tan-wall Corsa PRO Control TLR render from Vittoria's product page; the file name labels it as the 38-42 mm version.
image.alt: Vittoria Corsa PRO Control TLR tire render with tan sidewalls and red logo

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out.

reports.summary: Excellent grip, very smooth and surprisingly fast.
High comfort on poor roads without giving up speed; about as fast as a 40 mm Schwalbe G-One RS Pro and slightly more supple.
Comfortable at lower pressure with supple sidewalls and no puncture so far; hard to fit on the owner's rims.
Rolls smoothly and fast at 80 psi and feels very sure in corners.
Does a splendid job on rough UK roads; not slow, but slower than a GP5000 S TR or the regular Corsa Pro.
Supple sidewalls with a thick tread; no flat so far.

reports.exposure: About 40 miles, then a few more rides
reports.summary: Feels faster than its lab result and has a great road feel, but the owner regrets not choosing the regular Corsa Pro after its puncture-test result.

checks.note: One of 6 written reviews only repeats other reviews
Two of 3 written reviews describe only mounting or a first impression
